title: Trace record
description: One record per line in traces.jsonl: the extracted ion chromatogram for one ion. Optional file. Emitted only for selected or annotated ions, since a trace per library ion would dwarf the rest of the export. An ion may have several traces: one per isotope when isotope_k is set.

isotope_k.description: Which isotope this trace follows: 0 = monoisotopic, 1 = M+1, ... Null means the precursor XIC as a whole. Emitting k = 0, 1 and 2 for the same ion lets a consumer follow each isotope ratio scan by scan across the peak (contract section 11).
